checklist.item: Settings › Assistant read-only: default provider oMLX (unreachable) shows 'Active' + green dot
Assistant space: New chat → 'hello' to unreachable oMLX (feedback in ~1.1 s: only 'Retrying … chat-only mode', no error/Retry/settings link; task 'completed')
First-run empty chat list (simulated GET /chats → []): welcome state + green default pill, no provider guidance
Model pill → OpenAI (no key) → send: 400 'API key required for provider: OpenAI', no CTA, Retry = resend 400; banner off-screen in long chat
Dock Cmd+I on Schem + PCB: send to unreachable provider; OpenAI no-key in dock
Dock with hung local provider (black-hole listener on :8000): Working…/Stop, Stop, reload mid-run, second send, queue, no timeout (6m51s)
Assistant space chat selection after 'Open in Assistant view' (jumps back on refresh)
Runtime theme switch via Settings Dark→Light→Back on Schem/PCB/3D/Library list+detail/wizard draw/Assistant/Docs vs fresh-reload baseline (pixel diff: identical)
Runtime theme switch Light→Dark via Settings vs fresh dark (identical); Settings screen runtime vs fresh (identical)
System preference + live OS scheme change (emulateMedia) with Schem/PCB/Library/menu mounted — schematic palette stuck
Portalled menu (Library 'Component actions') during live theme switch → --menu-bg follows
Library list GET 500: first open, search keystroke, facet toggle; unroute + recovery
Library /facets 500: silent empty rail + wrong counts; recovery on search
Comments: 2000-char body, unbroken 300-char URL (wraps OK), 25 replies (opens at top, reply not scrolled), 31 threads (crowding, edge clipping, offscreen chips), latency (<2 ms API)
Comments list GET 500 on design open: silent, no retry; post during failure; unroute recovery needs view switch
Drag a comment pin (works, persisted; thread updatedAt not bumped)
Popup near right edge at 1100 flips left (OK); wheel over popup scrolls popup not canvas (OK)
Light contrast probes: assistant warning text (#364153 OK), pill dot raw emerald, comment popup meta 10px #a8a8ad on white (same as F1B-023)

known.evidence: List-load failure path also renders the same bare red error line ('HTTP 500') with no retry/dismiss; see F2C-006 (shots/f2c/dark/070-072).

For an unreachable local provider (ECONNREFUSED) the dock does NOT hang: the run completes in ~30 ms with a misleading 'Retrying … chat-only mode' line (F2C-001). For a hung local server the dock shows Working…/Stop (Stop works) but there is no timeout, and a post-reload second send orphans the run (F2C-002).
After reload mid-run the dock bubble DID restore 'Working… Stop', but the composer showed Send (enabled) instead of 'Stop generating'. Cancelled runs render as empty 'Assistant' bubbles after reload.
The OpenAI no-key 400 banner rendered at top=-592px in a long chat (shots/f2c/light/115-1100-openai-nokey-light.png).
Cancelled chats keep the grey run dot in the Assistant list (probe #606064, shots/f2c/dark/022, 024).
The schematic comment popup shares the 10px #a8a8ad-on-white timestamp (light), so it is the same root.
Tab badge stayed r0/r4 while design was at r13.
